title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy report-uri uses a plaintext endpoint
description: A CSP report-uri declaration points at a plaintext endpoint. Every violation report sends the blocked resource URL, the document URL and policy details to that endpoint, so the reporting channel itself becomes a cleartext channel about the user’s browsing context.
applicability: Responses that deliver a Content-Security-Policy with violation reporting.
risk: Browsing context and blocked-URL information readable on the path; LOW severity because no credentials are included by the report format itself.
